title: Siren Head
blurb: Trevor Henderson posted a photograph of a very tall creature with sirens for a head in 2018, and the internet has been afraid of it ever since. Its voice is corrupted emergency broadcast — snatches of alert tones, distorted speech, and the specific wrongness of a warning system that has begun making decisions of its own. That is a genuinely clever piece of horror design, because the sound is familiar before it becomes frightening. Play it for horror edits, or in woodland, entirely at your own risk. Camping trips have been ruined this way.
origin: The signature wail of Trevor Henderson's Siren Head cryptid.
